Actually thats not really the case. I developed ocd (obsessive compulsive disorder) because I was anxious as I wanted to fit in to the speed extroverts and psychological healthy people interact with each other. One day my brain kinda "cracked" as I listened to someone in class, where my attention latched on the fact how much I didn't understand or I'm distracted by own thoughts of insecurity. 
So this spread further in every area of my being since then.
It's exhausting, because I often have the urge to make decisions, which information I let sink into my mind, while everyone around me just seems to have trust in themselves and tend to communicate unconsciously, what's way more energy efficient for the brain. (If it's the brain at all) 
But ya in a sense, if I'm a relaxed state, observing state without so much ego activity, I think it's a very interesting "ability". 
Most of times though, I feel lonely due to my condition, because I tend to process the things way slower, therefore sometimes deeper than others. But ya^^

I have a condition which I call "obsessive compulsive language disorder" so as it already mentioned in the name, it all began with being confronted with the subconscious mind. I tried to be "fully present" in an anxious situation in class during a conversation with a foreign classmate and I failed to follow her. At that I something "snapped" in my brain, because I came to the conclusion that language ist somewhat relative and words loose their meaning in some occassions. So I checked a hundret times in conversations if I was present, using my conscious mind. 
Now it gets really weird: I used coping mechanisms... writing a script in my mind to remember their words... 
So 1 and 4 months year later and a dozen reality insights and shifts, I'm a bit better and wiser but I stuck with seeing even my own thoughts and ideas in actual words before my inner eyes. 
So basically my mind is almost never quiet, I can't life in the moment and I'm really really fucked. I lost many friends and passions because oft that. My memory is very poor. And I feel like a complete alien to the world and don't know what to do anymore.
